name: Construction / Projects
description: Contractors, civil works, installation, infrastructure and interior vendors. The highest-risk category: site work brings statutory licensing, worker insurance and safety obligations that transfer to the buyer if unchecked.

fields.label: Trade / specialisation
fields.why: Determines which trade licence we need to verify.

fields.label: Typical project value
fields.why: Projects above our threshold need performance security before work starts.

fields.label: Workers deployed on site
fields.why: Any worker on our premises must be covered by your workers' compensation policy.

documents.label: Contractor / trade licence
documents.why: Site work without a valid licence exposes both parties to statutory penalties.
documents.expects: A government-issued contractor or trade licence naming the business

documents.label: Workers' compensation insurance
documents.why: Legally required the moment your people set foot on our site.
documents.expects: A workers' compensation or employer's liability certificate naming the business

documents.label: Health & safety certification
documents.why: Larger crews require a documented safety management system.
documents.expects: A health and safety certification or safety policy document naming the business

documents.label: Performance bond / bank guarantee
documents.why: Standard protection on large projects; released on completion.
documents.expects: A bank guarantee or performance bond naming the business and a value
